extracted.intended_audience: writers (authors) seeking book publication with Catapult; readers curious about the publisher's editorial mission
extracted.subtask_description: Selection criteria and editorial mission statements describing the kinds of books Catapult seeks to publish—primarily literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction that engage themes of perception, diversity, and craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Catapult publishes literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target submissions should be literary fiction or narrative nonfiction with a focus on craft and artful storytelling rather than genre commercial fiction or purely informational nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement with the 'Perception Box' theme
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts should engage with our Perception Box, the powerful metaphor we use to define the structure and boundaries of how we see others in their full humanity, and invite new ways of seeing and being seen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that interrogates or reframes how characters/people are perceived—inviting readers to shift perspectives—is especially aligned with the imprint's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tonal and qualitative qualities
rubrics_metrics.description: Our books are alive, insightful, illuminating, and surprising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are expected to demonstrate vitality and the capacity to reveal new insights or unexpected angles; avoid flat, predictable storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorial voice and craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Written by vital voices—emerging and established—that honor the craft of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catapult values strong, distinctive authorial voices and technical mastery of prose; both emerging and established authors who show craft are considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ambition to challenge assumptions and biases
rubrics_metrics.description: Our books embrace writers and audiences who fearlessly shake up our assumptions and biases; and who believe in the power of storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for work that provocatively challenges conventional viewpoints, prompts reflection, or unsettles readers' preconceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complexity and openness (raises questions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrate stories that explore the space between the lines of our lives, that raise questions rather than give answers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narratives that tolerate ambiguity and complexity—favoring inquiry and layered meaning over didactic resolution—are sought after.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expands boundaries of identity and knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Rattle the walls of our Perception Box—expanding the boundaries of who we think we are, and what we think we know.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should broaden readers' understanding of self and others, expanding empathetic or intellectual horizons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to diverse and historically underrepresented voices
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with a diverse list of writers who have been historically underrepresented, broadening the literary landscape in the United States and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial preference includes amplifying marginalized voices and stories that diversify the published literary conversation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Readerly and writerly effort / engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: We embrace writing that requires an effort on the part of both writer and reader to reach beyond our assumptions and biases to see the humanity, struggle, and truth in every human being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should invite active engagement—demanding interpretive work from readers and demonstrating the author's investment in deepening empathy and understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing values: care, intention, and respect for authors
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to publishing with care, intention, and respect for our authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While not a content criterion, this signals the publisher's editorial approach and relationship expectations: thoughtful editorial collaboration and respectful treatment of authors.
